name: lichess-bot
description: A multi-account Lichess automation service with extensible chess engines and a React dashboard.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/clean-build.ts && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.build.json && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && oxlint --deny-warnings apps packages tests scripts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts docs README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests scripts docs README.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md
